en.title: Israeli strikes on Gaza hospitals
en.dek: Multiple attacks on medical facilities in southern Gaza kill and injure dozens.

de.title: Israelische Angriffe auf Krankenhäuser in Gaza

fr.title: Frappes israéliennes sur des hôpitaux à Gaza

ja.title: イスラエルによるガザの病院への攻撃

ko.title: 이스라엘, 가자 병원 공격
